node: What opens over any view: questions, the live trial and the screen below the minimum size
The quit question: changes are not saved
reach: q while changes are not saved
leave: y saves and quits; n quits without saving; Esc and Ctrl-C go back to where q was pressed
keys: y.question.quit, n.question.quit, esc.question, ctrl-c.question, q.question, tab.question, shift-tab.question, other.question, key-line.any

node: The leave question: new or removed font sets wait for an install
reach: q while font set changes wait in memory
leave: y installs and quits; n saves the changes that are not saved and quits without installing; Esc and Ctrl-C go back
keys: y.question.leave, n.question.leave, i.question.leave, l.question.leave, esc.question, ctrl-c.question, q.question, tab.question, shift-tab.question, other.question, key-line.any

node: A question before an action: Install, Revert, Restore, New, or deleting a look
reach: i, r, n, or Enter on Restore's list
leave: y acts; n where offered, Esc and Ctrl-C go back without acting
keys: y.question, n.question, esc.question, ctrl-c.question, q.question, tab.question, shift-tab.question, other.question, key-line.any

node: Let programs resize the grid?
reach: w in looks while allow-window-ops is off
leave: y writes allow-window-ops = on and n, Esc and Ctrl-C write nothing, all to looks
keys: y.question, n.question, esc.question, ctrl-c.question, q.question, tab.question, shift-tab.question, other.question, key-line.any

node: The live trial's countdown: a font set or a size tried on the console
reach: t in looks or on a card's font set field; Enter on a size in looks
leave: k keeps it; any other key or the countdown's end puts it back; both return to where the trial began
keys: k.trial, other.trial, q.trial, esc.trial, tab.trial, shift-tab.trial, ctrl-c.trial

node: The screen below 80×25, which draws no view

keys: q.too-small, u.too-small, other.too-small, esc.too-small, tab.too-small, shift-tab.too-small, ctrl-c.too-small
